sources.name: Pexels
sources.creditNotes: Docs: show a prominent link to Pexels (e.g. 'Photos provided by Pexels') whenever API results are shown; credit photographers when possible, linking to the photo page (and photographer profile in the doc example).
sources.cache: UNVERIFIED: no caching duration stated in API docs (license/terms pages returned HTTP 403).
sources.rateLimit: 200 requests/hour and 20,000 requests/month by default; free unlimited on request if attribution is shown. Headers X-Ratelimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset on 2xx only; 429 when exceeded.
sources.license: Pexels License (free for commercial/non-commercial use); full text UNVERIFIED (https://www.pexels.com/license/ returned 403)
unverified: hotlink rule (docs do not forbid it; sample src URLs are on images.pexels.com)

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.creditNotes: Docs only request: show users where images/videos come from whenever results are displayed. Exact credit wording is not in the docs; 'Image by {author} from Pixabay' is the conventional wording (UNVERIFIED).
sources.cache: Requests must be cached for 24 hours. Image URLs may be used only for temporarily displaying search results; webformatURL is valid 24 hours. Permanent hotlinking is not allowed: download images to your own server first.
sources.rateLimit: 100 requests per 60 seconds per API key (headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset); 429 'API rate limit exceeded'. Max 500 results per query. No systematic mass downloads.
sources.license: Pixabay Content License (https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/ returned 403, text UNVERIFIED)

sources.name: Unsplash
sources.creditNotes: Must credit Unsplash and the photographer, linking to the photographer's Unsplash profile. All links back to Unsplash must append ?utm_source=your_app_name&utm_medium=referral.
sources.downloadTriggerNotes: Required: GET photo.links.download_location (authorized with client_id/Authorization, keep its query params like ixid) whenever a user chooses/uses the photo (inserting or setting it somewhere). Do it asynchronously. Event only; do not use it to embed the image.
sources.hotlinkNotes: REQUIRED: all uses must use the hotlinked photo.urls.* URLs returned by the API (not only in search results). Resize via URL params (w=, etc.).
sources.cache: UNVERIFIED: no cache duration found in the docs/guidelines pages read (https://unsplash.com/api-terms and /license returned no body text). Image URLs must stay hotlinked, so do not copy files to your own storage.
sources.rateLimit: Demo mode 50 requests/hour; production (after approval) 1000 requests/hour. Only api.unsplash.com JSON requests count; images.unsplash.com file requests do not.
sources.license: Unsplash License (attribution not legally required by the licence, but required by API guidelines); licence text UNVERIFIED (unsplash.com/license returned no body text)
unverified: tags field in search results (alt_description/description documented)

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons

auth.userAgent: Send a descriptive User-Agent: <client>/<version> (<contact URL or email>) <library>/<version>, e.g. SousChef/1.0 (https://example.org/souschef; contact@example.org). From browser JS use the Api-User-Agent header. Generic/browser-copied/empty UAs may be blocked (HTTP 403).

sources.safeSearchNotes: No safe-search parameter. Filter on your side (e.g. require food-related terms/categories, reject titles/categories you do not want).

fields.author: imageinfo[0].extmetadata.Artist.value (HTML; strip tags)
fields.authorUrl: href inside extmetadata.Artist.value (may be missing or a redlink)

sources.creditNotes: Credit the creator named in the file's Artist field (not the uploader), name the licence (link to LicenseUrl) and link to the file page. Attribution rules differ per file; check AttributionRequired and Restrictions.
sources.hotlinkNotes: Commons says hotlinking is possible but 'not recommended' (COM:REUSE). Thumbnails come from thumb.wikimedia.org / upload.wikimedia.org. Detail on COM:REUSE/technical was not read (UNVERIFIED).
sources.cache: No fixed duration. MediaWiki API etiquette: cache data that can be cached; prefer GET.
sources.rateLimit: No hard limit on read requests; make requests in series, not parallel; use gzip; batch titles with |; block risk without a proper User-Agent. extmetadata is expensive: request few results at a time.
sources.license: Per file: mostly CC BY, CC BY-SA, GFDL or public domain, read from extmetadata
sources.uaPolicyNote: meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User-Agent_policy returned an empty body when fetched; the same policy was read at the foundation.wikimedia.org URL.
